english_json: "Thou hast filled Thy household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever comfort us, we beseech Thee, through her intercession whose festival we celebrate. Through our Lord."
"May the offering of Thy consecrated people be accepted by Thee, O Lord, in honor of Thy saints, by whose merits it knoweth that it hath received aid in time of trouble. Through our Lord."
"May Thy saints, we beseech Thee, O Lord, everywhere make us joyful, that, while we venerate their merits, we may experience their patronage. Through our Lord."
"Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that we who on earth discharge with joy the duty of honouring Thy saints may be gladdened by their company forever in heaven. Through our Lord."
"Filled with the mysteries of salvation, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose festival we celebrate. Through our Lord."

"Receive, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the prayers of Thy people, with the offerings of sacrifices, that the sacred mysteries begun with these sacraments of Easter may avail us under grace a remedy unto life everlasting. Through our Lord."
